description: 经典微信绿 - 以微信品牌绿为核心，亲切可信、接近公众号原生语境，适合服务 / 社群 / 通用内容

styles.body: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.78; letter-spacing: 0.2px; padding: 12px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px;
styles.h1: display: block; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #163325; line-height: 1.32; margin: 36px 0 16px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; padding: 12px 16px 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,193,96,0.08) 0%, rgba(7,193,96,0.03) 100%); border-left: 5px solid #07c160; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(22,51,37,0.2); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(7,193,96,0.05);
styles.h2: display: block; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #067647; line-height: 1.4; margin: 34px 0 18px; padding: 10px 14px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7,193,96,0.12) 0%, rgba(7,193,96,0.03) 70%, rgba(7,193,96,0) 100%); border-left: 4px solid #07c160; border-radius: 12px;
styles.h3: display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0a6c44; line-height: 1.42; margin: 28px 0 14px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(7,193,96,0.5);
styles.blockquote: margin: 22px 0; padding: 16px 18px; color: #1f4d37; background: #f0fbf5; border: 1px solid #cae9d8; border-left: 3px solid #07c160; border-radius: 0 9px 9px 0; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.8;
styles.strong: font-weight: 700; color: #067647; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,193,96,0) 0%, rgba(7,193,96,0) 58%, rgba(7,193,96,0.16) 58%, rgba(7,193,96,0.16) 100%); padding: 0 3px;
styles.code_inline: font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; padding: 3px 6px; background-color: #f0f7f2; color: #07c160; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5;
styles.code_block: margin: 1.05em 0; padding: 1em; background: #0f2d1f; color: #ecfff4; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6;
styles.li_bullet: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #07c160; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900;
styles.li_number: display: inline-block; min-width: 25px; margin-right: 9px; color: #07c160; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; vertical-align: -1px;
styles.hr: margin: 36px auto; border: none; height: 2px; width: 62%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7,193,96,0) 0%, rgba(7,193,96,0.22) 20%, rgba(7,193,96,0.68) 50%, rgba(7,193,96,0.22) 80%, rgba(7,193,96,0) 100%);
styles.a: color: #067647; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(7,193,96,0.45);
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 22px 0; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #cde8db; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; table-layout: fixed; word-break: break-word;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #cde8db; padding: 8px 10px; background: #f3fbf7; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #067647;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #cde8db; padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top;
styles.caption: font-size: 12.5px; color: #7a7f87; text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.section_divider: text-align: center; color: #07c160; letter-spacing: 10px; font-size: 11px; margin: 36px 0; user-select: none; opacity: 0.65;

highlights.hl_yellow: background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 58%, #fff0a6 58%); color: #163325; padding: 0 3px; font-weight: 600;
